paragraphs.text: Intelligent document processing, often shortened to IDP, combines OCR, which turns images of text into machine-readable text, with AI that understands what the text means. It can tell an invoice number from a GST number, find the total even when layouts differ and match line items to purchase orders.
The result is structured, checked data ready for your business systems, not just a block of scanned text.

IDP vs OCR is an important difference. Basic OCR data extraction reads characters but does not understand them, so it usually needs a fixed template for each document layout. When a supplier changes its invoice design, the template breaks.

Intelligent document processing uses AI to understand documents by meaning, so it handles new layouts, multiple languages and messy scans far better. It also checks results, flags uncertain fields and learns from corrections.

items.title: Invoice Automation
items.text: Invoice automation captures supplier name, invoice number, dates, GST details, line items, taxes and totals from PDF or scanned invoices, checks them against purchase orders and sends them for approval or posting.

items.title: Invoice to Tally Automation
items.text: Invoice to Tally automation posts extracted invoice data into Tally as vouchers, with the right ledgers and tax details, removing one of the most time-consuming tasks for Indian accounts teams. We also connect to Zoho Books, QuickBooks and other accounting tools.

items.title: Purchase Order Processing
items.text: Purchase order processing reads incoming customer POs, extracts items, quantities, prices and delivery dates, and creates sales orders in your system for review.

items.title: Receipt and Expense Scanning
items.text: Receipt and expense scanning lets employees photograph receipts on their phones. AI extracts the vendor, date, amount and tax, categorises the expense and adds it to the claim.

items.title: Contract Data Extraction
items.text: Contract data extraction pulls key terms, such as parties, dates, renewal periods, payment terms and obligations, into a searchable register with reminders for important dates.

items.title: KYC Document Verification
items.text: KYC document verification reads details from ID cards, passports and address proofs, checks them against application data and flags mismatches or missing documents for staff review.

items.title: Handwritten Form Extraction
items.text: Handwritten form extraction reads filled paper forms, such as applications, delivery notes and inspection checklists. Accuracy depends on handwriting quality, so we always include human review for uncertain fields.

items.title: Arabic OCR
items.text: Arabic OCR supports businesses handling documents from Gulf customers and suppliers, including mixed Arabic and English invoices, trade licences and shipping documents.

paragraphs.text: Document classification AI sorts incoming documents automatically, identifying whether each file is an invoice, PO, receipt, delivery note or contract, and sends it to the right process. This is especially useful for shared inboxes that receive many document types every day.

sections.h2: How Accurate Is AI Document Processing?

paragraphs.text: How accurate is AI document processing? On clear, typed documents, field-level accuracy is typically very high. Accuracy falls with poor scans, unusual layouts and handwriting. Rather than promising perfection, we measure accuracy on your own sample documents before launch and design the workflow around the results.

Human review for extracted data is built into every project. Each extracted field receives a confidence score. High-confidence fields pass through automatically, while uncertain fields are highlighted for a staff member to check in a simple review screen. Corrections are recorded and used to improve future results.

Document data security is critical, since invoices, contracts and ID documents contain sensitive information. We use encrypted storage and transfer, role-based access, audit logs and providers with clear data-processing terms. Documents can be deleted automatically after processing, and setups can be designed to keep data in India where needed.

Your volumes are growing faster than your accounts or operations team

outro.text: Even a few hundred documents a month can justify automation if each one takes several minutes to process by hand.

items.title: AI Document Processing for Logistics
items.text: AI document processing for logistics handles bills of lading, airway bills, commercial invoices, packing lists, delivery notes and customs documents, where speed and accuracy affect shipment times and costs.

paragraphs.text: Accounting firms, manufacturers, distributors, hospitals, banks, insurance agents and educational institutions also process large volumes of documents that benefit from automation.

sections.h2: How Much Does Document Processing Automation Cost?

paragraphs.text: How much does document processing automation cost? It depends on document types, monthly volumes, layout variety, languages and integrations. Costs include a one-time setup fee, per-page AI processing charges and optional monthly support. We give you an estimate after testing your samples, along with expected time saved. For steady monthly volumes, a fixed monthly plan is also possible, which makes monthly budgeting much simpler for finance teams.
Ask us for a document processing case study relevant to your industry. We share details only with client approval and can demonstrate extraction on your own sample documents.

items.q: What file formats can you process?
items.a: We handle PDFs, scanned images, phone photos, Word files, Excel sheets and email attachments. Documents can be collected automatically from a shared inbox, a cloud folder, WhatsApp or an upload page.

items.q: Do we need to scan documents in a special way?
items.a: No special equipment is needed. Clear phone photos and standard office scans work well. We share simple tips, such as good lighting and flat pages, to keep accuracy high.

items.q: Can the system handle documents from new suppliers?
items.a: Yes. Because the AI reads documents by meaning rather than fixed templates, new layouts are usually handled without extra setup. Any uncertain fields go to human review, and the system improves as corrections are made.

items.q: What happens to documents after processing?
items.a: You decide. Documents can be stored securely in your cloud drive or document system, linked to the related record, or deleted automatically after a set period.

items.q: Can extracted data be exported to Excel?
items.a: Yes. Alongside direct posting to your software, extracted data can be exported to Excel or Google Sheets on demand or on a schedule, which helps with audits, reconciliations and management reports.

items.q: How quickly is each document processed?
items.a: Most documents are read and validated within seconds to a minute after they arrive. The total time then depends on whether any fields need human review and how quickly your team approves them. Many clients clear the previous day's documents before lunch instead of spending several days catching up at month end.
